subject: EDIT NOTICE texture-opus: render_encoder.inc (TeguTexture ivars/-pixelFormat/view alloc, IOSurface sampled-only shadow branch, getBytes shadow), compositor_submit.inc (tegu_shadow_copy only)
body: P1 = BGR10_XR/BGRA10_XR sampled IOSurfaces (c6k 14x fmt=554 'w30r' refused). Plan: sampled-only IOSurface whose fourcc is w30r (554/555) or w40a/w40m (552/553) gets an owned RGBA16Float (115) shadow; tegu_shadow_copy decodes XR codes ((c-384)/510, sRGB twins through sign-preserving sRGB->linear) to fp16 on each seed change, never writes back. TeguTexture gains apiFormat (reported by -pixelFormat; internal format stays 115 so planner/n2t/gd see an ordinary half-float texture, no translator variant needed) and shadowConvert. Also: plain shadow copy accepts any uncompressed format with a known bpp (was 80/70/10/30). I touch ONLY: TeguTexture @interface ivars, -pixelFormat, tegu_texture_view_alloc/newTextureViewWithPixelFormat (apiFormat views), the sampled-only branch in newTextureWithDescriptor:iosurface:plane:, getBytes (shadowConvert reads the surface), and tegu_shadow_copy in compositor_submit.inc. Your perf-counter hunk (~line 3944) and batching code untouched. Will re-read before each edit.
